_source: Twilight: 2000 4th Edition, Player's Manual -- character generation extract (T2k_Players_Manual_220804_Char-Gen.pdf). PDF page = printed page - 13.
_scope: Rules mechanics only (tables, target numbers, procedure), transcribed to run a character generator. No rulebook prose is reproduced beyond the short table entries needed to make a roll.
_method: LIFE PATH (printed p31). The archetype method (printed p20-30) is NOT implemented.
_vtt_note: Identifies this game to the VTT's character import. Read from DATA rather than hardcoded, matching the Traveller-family engines.

descriptions.STR: Muscle power, toughness, and physical endurance
descriptions.AGL: Body control, speed, and fine motor skills

attributes.trade_down: You may gain one extra increase by decreasing one attribute from C to D.

_skill_note: F is the default and is not written on the sheet. A skill taken for the first time starts at D. No skill can ever go above A.

cuf._note: Coolness Under Fire, rated A-D like an attribute. Increases one step on a promotion in a military OR intelligence career.

derived.hit_capacity: (STR die size + AGL die size) / 4, rounded up
derived.stress_capacity: (INT die size + EMP die size) / 4, rounded up
derived._example: STR B and AGL C give hit capacity 5 (rounded up from 4.5). INT B and EMP D give stress capacity 4.

unit_morale.rule: The group's starting unit morale equals the highest COMMAND skill level in the group.
unit_morale._note: A group score, not a personal one. Solo output shows this character's own COMMAND as their contribution.

term.skill_increases_per_term: Increase two skills one step each, or one skill two steps.
term.skill_sources: The skills listed for the career this term, OR the generally available skills STAMINA, MOBILITY and DRIVING.
term.first_military_term: In your FIRST term of military service one of your skill increases MUST be RANGED COMBAT, no matter what skills are listed.
term.nco_command: At the rank of Corporal or above you can always choose COMMAND as a skill increase.

promotion.check: One unmodified skill roll using one of the skills you increased this term. The roll cannot be pushed.
promotion.on_success: Roll D6 on the career's specialty table to learn a specialty. If you roll one you already have, choose any specialty instead. In a military career also increase military rank one step. In a military OR intelligence career also increase CUF one step, to a maximum of A.

ageing.effect: If the D8 result is LOWER than the number of terms completed, reduce one attribute of your choice by one step. Cannot go below D.
ageing._note: This means an attribute reduction can never happen directly after the first term.

war.effect: If the D8 result is LOWER than the number of terms completed, war breaks out -- go to the At War term. Otherwise choose a career for the next term.

at_war.skills: Increase any two skills of your choice by one step each. You cannot increase one skill two steps.
at_war.specialty: Roll D6 on the At War table using the column for your most recent career term. Re-roll (or choose) if you already have it.
at_war.no_promotion: Do NOT roll for promotion or age effects after the At War term.

draft.when: Your final term before war broke out was civilian (EXCEPT intelligence careers) AND your character is not a local of the country where the game is set.
draft.effect: Your At War term is spent as a draftee or volunteer. One of the two At War skill increases must be RANGED COMBAT unless you already have D or better in it. Roll your specialty on the MILITARY column, and take starting gear as if your final pre-war term had been Combat Arms.

final_steps.gear: Pick gear from the choices given by your final career term BEFORE the At War term. In addition you get D6 rations of food, D6 rations of fresh water and D6 rounds of ammo to use as currency. You are also assumed to have a uniform or sturdy civilian clothing and a canteen.
final_steps.group_gear: Chosen by the group together, possibly including a vehicle (printed p18). Not granted here -- it is a table decision.
final_steps.rads: Roll D6 for starting permanent rads (printed p80).

nationality._rule: Nationality does not affect character generation beyond gear and language (printed p15).
nationality.languages: Every character knows their native language. All PCs know at least a little English, and everyone from a former Warsaw Pact country knows a little Russian. Further languages are the Linguist specialty.

local_militia.rule: For local militia, war automatically breaks out by the end of their FIRST term -- one term on the military table, plus the benefits of the At War career.
local_militia.also: Local militia always know the area, have multiple contacts there, have a home there, and speak the local language fluently.

ranks._source: printed p15. A dash means that armed force has no equivalent rank.

childhood._source: printed p32. Roll D6, or choose if the Referee allows. Take ONE listed skill at level D, then roll D6 for one specialty.

moral_code_examples: You have a moral obligation to help those worse off than you.
War is a glorious thing and you are meant to command.
Freedom is everything. No one tells you what to do. Ever.
big_dream_examples: You were sent here to win this war. You intend to do just that, at any cost.
Find a place to settle down with your friends, and defend it with your life.
Find your parents. You were separated. You want them back.
